page.layout: Running head across the top: "Enzinas." at left, "LIBER V." centred, page number "151" at right. Above the first rule, one full-width text block of justified paragraphs continuing from the previous page. Below it, a full-width title "Liber quintus Actionum MARTYRUM.", the name line "N. ENZINAS BVRGENSIS Hispanus," with a subtitle, then one column of text with a large woodcut initial, running in the main body. Printed marginal notes on the right: "Henricus rex Angliæ moritur.", "M.D.XLVI.", "Franciscus Dryander." Handwritten annotations in the right margin are not transcribed. Signature "V. iij." at the foot, bottom right of the text block.

page.notes: Handwritten annotations in the right margin (a note beginning "Ciuitas"/"Sancto", a Greek-looking mark, and "Lingua ... Galilaeus" with a Greek sign) are manuscript, not printed, and are not transcribed. "Ic[?]" at the start of the body: the large woodcut initial is hard to read; the first letter and word are uncertain. The italic passage is read from the scan's slanted type and may be partly roman.
